brand_identity.name: FloForge Automations
brand_identity.target_audience: Contractors, local businesses, trades (HVAC, plumbing, construction)
brand_identity.tone: Professional, authoritative, highly functional, data-dense, crisp

pairing_rules: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, UI elements, data tables, and forms.
Strictly DO NOT USE Inter, Geist, or Space Grotesk.

typesetting.data_tables: Use tabular-nums for all numbers and pricing to ensure precise alignment.
typesetting.labels: Uppercase, tight tracking (tracking-wider), very small (text-xs) for table headers.

shadows.replacement: Use 1px crisp solid borders (border border-slate-300). For elevation (modals), use a slightly darker background shade or a thicker/darker border (e.g., border-slate-900) instead of a drop shadow.

radii.strategy: CRITICAL: No bubbly/pill-shaped overly rounded corners.
radii.classes: Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded (4px) maximum. Buttons, inputs, and cards must feel sharp and technical.

icons_and_assets.icon_usage: Use Phosphor icons with sharp/regular weight. Ensure precise alignment with text.

images.strategy: Use real contractor/industry images. DO NOT use fake product screenshots (use real data tables or none).

landing_page.strategy: Avoid 'AI slop' layout patterns. Use structured, editorial grids or full-width horizontal sections separated by crisp 1px borders.
landing_page.alternatives: Use 2-column asymmetric split (e.g., 40/60) for features, or list them vertically with strong typography.

pricing_page.strategy: DO NOT use a classic 3-column pricing table.
pricing_page.alternative: Use a stacked horizontal layout. Row 1: Starter Setup ($299). Row 2: Business Automation ($699). Row 3: Growth Partnership ($149/mo). Each row should be a full-width block with details spanning horizontally across columns.

dashboards.sidebar: Fixed width (w-64), Off-white background with a 1px border-r (border-slate-200). Use small, crisp navigation links (text-sm) with minimal hover states (bg-slate-200, no scaling).
dashboards.tables: Data-dense. Use border-collapse, compact padding (py-2 px-3), tabular-nums, text-sm for data, text-xs uppercase for headers. Striped rows (bg-slate-50/bg-slate-100) or 1px border-b.
dashboards.charts: Use Recharts. Clean lines. DO NOT use area chart gradients under the line (use solid line charts or flat color area fill with no gradient). Colors: Emerald and Navy.

auth.hubspot_sso: Include 'Sign in with HubSpot' button (Off-white or Navy background, flat, 1px border).

banned_animations: Animated arrows (arrow nudges right on hover)
motion_and_interaction.allowed_animations: Crisp color transitions only. On hover, change background color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-200) or border color (e.g., hover:border-slate-900). Use fast durations (duration-150). No transforms.

banned_patterns: 'It's not X, it's Y' sentence construction
Checkmark bullet lists (Use numbers, squares, or heavy dots instead)
copywriting_rules.tone: Direct, authoritative, precise. Focus on metrics and real operational value.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Do not use transparent background in header or dropdown overlays; always use a solid Off-white background.
Build the dashboard shell with a strict grid or flex layout ensuring the sidebar is fixed and main content scrolls independently.
Do not center-align paragraphs; text should be left-aligned for a technical/documentary feel.
Use Recharts for the admin dashboard: `yarn add recharts`
